$comment: HAND-MAINTAINED. There is no parser and no derivation — nothing in the concert
data can know where the archive owner lived, or any other personal fact that
predates or sits outside the concert record. Add rows by hand, and only for a
fact the owner has actually confirmed.
Built for #529: the claim verifier flags a concrete personal fact stated as
fact ('personal-invented') because the archive data cannot know it. Most of
those really are invented. A few are true and the owner is willing to stand
behind them — those go here, so the verifier stops flagging them instead of
the copy having to avoid ever stating a fact that happens to be true.
Each entry is `fact` (a short first-person-ready statement, present to the
verifier as something the archive owner has confirmed) plus `note` (why it
is here / where it came from). Scope it in the fact itself when it is not
true for the whole archive's date range — 'around 1992' rather than a bare
claim that reads as always-true.
Consumed only by the liner notes / syndication claim-check pipeline
(scripts/liner-notes/fact-sheet.ts). The site, the Artist scene and the MCP
server do not read this file.
A fact absent from this file is not thereby false — it is simply unconfirmed,
and copy stating it as fact gets flagged 'personal-invented' until it is
either added here or rewritten to not need it.

facts.fact: I lived in Orange County, California, around 1992.
facts.note: Confirmed by the owner during the #527 review of the back catalogue.
